programs.description: A pride of lionesses reigns supreme on the banks of a river in Tanzania. They are merciless hunters, unrivalled in their fearlessness and strength.
Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures.
The intimate lives of lions, leopards and cheetahs of the Masai Mara; a journey of motherhood, survival, and territorial battles.
Exploring the natural wonders of Namibia, a country of contrasts in southern Africa that is home to diverse flora and fauna throughout its arid savannahs, flowing rivers, and rugged coastlines.

The seasonal changes of the Luangwa Valley are extraordinarily intense. Heavy rains transform the Luangwa River from a shallow channel into a majestic waterway where grass grows tall and streams fill with an abundant selection of creatures.

Across the planet, wolves and lions lead two legendary predator lineages: canids and felines. We explore their differences and similarities, from brute strength to social intelligence, revealing who dominates in each territory.
An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.

Every year in Tanzania, the dry season hits the Ruaha reserve hard. To survive, animal populations come down from the high plateaus to reach the Ruaha river, where a troupe of lionesses waits patiently, poised for combat.

Set against Kyrgyzstan's rugged mountains, Dan O'Neill embarks on a mission to protect one of the world's most elusive creatures: the snow leopard. Following Dan as he works to build a new research centre dedicated to studying these majestic cats.
Exploring the natural wonders of Namibia, a country of contrasts in southern Africa that is home to diverse flora and fauna throughout its arid savannahs, flowing rivers, and rugged coastlines.
An unforgettable expedition across diverse landscapes of Africa exploring the fascinating lives of their extraordinary inhabitants.
Bringing the best in television.
Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures.

From the mighty lions of Africa and the elusive snow leopards of Asia to the pumas of the North American mountains and the jaguars of the Amazon. These stunningly graceful animals are some of the most vicious and territorial on the planet.
The filmmaker delves into the misunderstood rivalry between lions and hyenas, shedding light on their conflict and offering new insights into their complex relationship.
Life around the planet, including births and deaths, joyous moments and dangerous situations.
The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.
An eight-part docuseries exploring Earth's major eras and extinction events across 450 million years alongside the creatures who fought to survive.
Exploring the lives of big cats, shining a light on the worlds of leopards, lions, and cheetahs.

Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.
Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings.

The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship.
Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures.

Although scientists have studied the ecology of African predators for years, few animals are as cliché in the general perception as lions and hyenas: the 'noble kings of the savannah' on the one hand, and the 'cowardly scavengers' on the other.
Celebrating the drama and spectacle of the American wilderness, captured over the course of a turbulent and perilous year.

Prehistoric sharks rise from the dead as biologists investigate the superpredators that ruled the seas. Global expeditions yield new evidence of the strangest sharks to ever roam the ocean, and groundbreaking CGI technology brings them back to life.
The filmmaker showcases the biological ingenuity of desert animals that helps them survive in the Namib, one of the harshest places on Earth.

Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.
Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce.

A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive.

WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth.

Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.
